verdict.rationale: The NIW pages say Ellis Porter charges a flat attorney fee for the I-140 that covers RFE responses at no extra cost, with government and Adjustment of Status fees handled separately. The step-by-step page gives a concrete installment figure of $500/month over 14 months, with a 10% discount for paying in full, so a founder can infer the NIW cost before contacting the firm. Missing for 10: an explicitly stated flat-fee dollar amount, a priced service menu covering the firm's other offerings (O-1, H-1B, PERM, compliance), and independent corroboration of the pricing.
